main_text.p: *אשתבע, Ithpehal, אִשְׁתַּבַּע Ithpahel Ch. Juravit. Aphel אַשְׁבִּיעַ אַשְׁבַּע Adjuravit.
שְׁבוּעָתָא, שְׁבוּעָה Ch. Jusjurandum, juramentum, Psal. 106.26. Esth. 5.3. 1. Sam. 14.26. Constr. שְׁבוּעַת Eccl. 6.6.
שֵׁבַע Ch. Satiari, exsatiari, saturari, saturum esse. Pahel שַׁבַּע Satiare, saturare, Psal. 90.14. Aphel אַשְׁבַּע Idem, Psal. 107.9.

שָׁבַק Ch. & Syr. Sivit, liquit, reliquit, dimisit, permisit, concesit, remisit, condonavit. Ithpeh. אִשְׁתַּבַּק & Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּבַּק, Remitti, condonari, Numer. 15.28. Ezech. 24.8. Syr. Fut. ܢܫܒܩܘܢ Remittentur, Johan. 20.23. Item Relinqui, derelinqui. Praet. אִשְׁתַּבְקַת Relicta est, Jer. 49.25. Fut. לָא תִשְׁתַּבְקוּן Non derelinquemini, Jer. 49.11. ܠܐ ܢܫܒܩܘܢ Non relinquetur, Luc. 21.6.
שְׁבוּק Chald. Remissio, Condonatio, Jobi 2.1. Numer. 19.9. Jon.
שְׁבוּק Idem, וְהַנַּיִת שְׁבוּק כְּרָגָא לְפְלְכַיָא עֲבַר Et commodum vel privilegium remissionis tributi fecit regionibus, Esth. 2.18.
ܫܒܩܘܬܐ Syr. Idem: Item Dimissio, Repudiatio uxoris, ܫܒܩܘܬܐ ܕܐܢܬܬܐ Libellus repudii, Matthaei 19.7.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldaic words are given as best read from the scan; vowel points and some Syriac letters are uncertain and may differ from the printed forms.
